reference: Couples engaged in the series: Pam and Roy (long engagement, season 1, wedding called off in S3), Jim and Pam (Jim proposes at the rest stop, S5E1), Phyllis and Bob Vance (S3), Andy and Angela (Andy proposes, S4E14), Michael and Holly (Michael proposes in the office, S7E18), Angela and Robert Lipton, the Senator (S7E24), and Dwight and Angela (Dwight proposes with his grandmother's ring, she accepts, S9E22). Minor/offscreen: Kelly and Ravi (called her fiance, S9E1) and Kevin and Stacy (called his fiancee in passing, S2).

evidence.line: Pam: Roy's my fiance. We've been engaged about three years.
Pam: I didn't go through with the wedding. I got cold feet, a few days before.
Phyllis: I'm getting married to Bob Vance.
Holly: Andy proposed to one of your accountants.
Jim: Pam, will you marry me? Pam: Yes! [they embrace and kiss]
Jim: Pam and I are engaged.
Michael: Holly Flax, marrying me will you be? Holly: Your wife becoming me will I. [everyone cheers]
Pam [looking at an engagement ring on Angela's finger]: It's gorgeous, Angela. Angela: ... he got down on one knee, and he said, will you be a Senator's ...
Dwight kneels with the ring; Angela: Okay, yes...yes, I will! [they kiss]
Toby: Kelly Kapoor is gone. Her fiance Ravi was hired as a pediatrics professor at Miami university.
Kevin: Abby's my fiancee Stacy's daughter

list_items.item: Pam and Roy (engaged three years, never married)

caveats: Core = engagements shown on screen or central to a storyline. Phyllis-Bob is made optional because the engagement itself is never shown, only 'I'm getting married' (S3E1) and the wedding (S3E15); I would accept it as correct too. Kelly-Ravi and Kevin-Stacy are only mentioned in passing (optional). NOT engagements: Michael-Carol (he proposes in public, Carol says no, S3E6 sc.41, 'you were never really engaged'); Michael 'I'm getting married' to his mother is a joke (S5E6 sc.3, 'Psych'); Dwight-Esther (considered, not done, S9E22 sc.61); Andy-Jessica (ring carried, no proposal, S8E12 sc.9); Ryan-Kelly married on impulse without an engagement shown. Kevin's S5E16 sc.25 'my fiance' (Lynn) is an unreliable aside. Fan transcripts miss visual proposals, and some off-camera engagements (e.g. Roy-Laura) are not covered.
question: Which couples get engaged over the series?
